Yes. The main issue is the Supplier A payment due 26 Oct: there is a BDT 19,000 cash shortfall before changes. There is also a return window for BDT 9,200 of stock, and BDT 18,400 of stock expires within 60 days.

I proposed trimming the order by BDT 10,800, asking Supplier A for 20 more days on BDT 8,200, and a mobile-wallet loan for BDT 8,200 only as a fallback. These are not actions taken; please review and approve them in Actions. The loan fallback costs BDT 181.97. The return credit may arrive too late to cover the payment.
